comments.text: Should i buy aditya birla activ one max plan multi individual policy or family floater for 60 and 58 years old if they have no major health issue
comments.author: @sonukr-i7p

comments.text:
Hi! There’s no one-size-fits-all answer here. Whether a multi-individual policy or a family floater is better for 60 & 58-year-old parents depends on multiple factors like medical needs, budget, sum insured requirement, long-term premium sustainability, etc. Since both are entering a higher age bracket, a personalised cost vs benefit analysis becomes very important before deciding the structure. It’s best to connect with an experienced advisor who can evaluate the complete profile and guide accordingly.
